title: Imatinib and M351-0056 enhance the function of VISTA and ameliorate the development of SLE via IFN-I and noncanonical NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Yang, Lu; Zhang, Tingting; Wang, Penglu; Chen, Wenting; Liu, Wanmei; He, Xiaoyu; Zhang, Yuxin; Jin, Shasha; Luo, Zhijie; Zhang, Zunjian; Wang, Xinzhi; Liu, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子激动剂通过IFN-I和NF-kappaB通路增强VISTA功能以缓解SLE，虽涉及分子对接但核心是免疫调控与疾病治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: V-domain immunoglobulin suppressor of T-cell activation (VISTA), an important negative checkpoint protein, participates in immunoregulation. Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is an autoimmune disease in which patients exhibit high levels of autoantibodies and multi-organ tissue injury, primarily involving the kidney and skin. In wild-type (WT) mice and Vsir(-/-) mice with pristane-induced lupus-like disease, we found that VISTA deficiency exacerbated the lupus-like disease in mice, possibly through aberrant activation of type I interferon (IFN-I) signaling, CD4(+) T cell, and noncanonical nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) pathway. Surface plasmon resonance results showed that imatinib, an FDA-approved tyrosine kinase inhibitor, may have a high affinity for human VISTA-ECD with a K(D) value of 0.2009 muM. The biological activities of imatinib and VISTA agonist M351-0056 were studied in monocytes and T cells and in lupus-like disease murine model of chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) and lupus-prone MRL/lpr mice. VISTA small-molecule agonist reduced the cytokine production of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) and Jurkat cells and inhibited PBMCs proliferation. Moreover, they attenuated the levels of autoantibodies, renal injury, inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and immune cell expansion in the cGVHD mouse model and MRL/lpr mice. Our findings also demonstrated that VISTA small-molecule agonist ameliorated the development of SLE through improving aberrantly activated IFN-I signaling and noncanonical NF-kappaB pathway. In conclusion, VISTA has a protective effect on the development and progression of SLE. VISTA agonist M351-0056 and imatinib have been firstly demonstrated to attenuate SLE, suggesting interventions to enhance VISTA function may be effective in treating SLE. VISTA deficiency exacerbates pristane-induced lupus-like disease in mice by promoting activation of the IFN-I and noncanonical NF-kappaB pathway. Imatinib was screened as a small-molecule VISTA agonist by molecular docking, SPR, and cellular level experiments. VISTA agonists (M351-0056 and imatinib) alleviated lupus-like disease progression in the cGVHD mouse model and MRL/lpr mice by inhibiting activation of IFN-I and noncanonical NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: T细胞激活的V结构域免疫球蛋白抑制因子（VISTA）是一种重要的负性检查点蛋白，参与免疫调节。系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种自身免疫性疾病，患者表现出高水平的自身抗体和多器官组织损伤，主要涉及肾脏和皮肤。在野生型（WT）小鼠和Vsir(-/-)小鼠中，通过pristane诱导的狼疮样疾病模型，我们发现VISTA缺陷加剧了小鼠的狼疮样疾病，可能通过I型干扰素（IFN-I）信号、CD4(+) T细胞和非经典核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）通路的异常激活。表面等离子体共振结果显示，伊马替尼（一种FDA批准的酪氨酸激酶抑制剂）可能与人VISTA-ECD具有高亲和力，K(D)值为0.2009 μM。在单核细胞和T细胞以及慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGVHD）狼疮样疾病小鼠模型和狼疮倾向的MRL/lpr小鼠中，研究了伊马替尼和VISTA激动剂M351-0056的生物学活性。VISTA小分子激动剂减少了外周血单核细胞（PBMCs）和Jurkat细胞的细胞因子产生，并抑制了PBMCs的增殖。此外，它们在cGVHD小鼠模型和MRL/lpr小鼠中减弱了自身抗体水平、肾损伤、炎症细胞因子、趋化因子和免疫细胞扩增。我们的发现还表明，VISTA小分子激动剂通过改善异常激活的IFN-I信号和非经典NF-kappaB通路，缓解了SLE的发展。总之，VISTA对SLE的发生和进展具有保护作用。VISTA激动剂M351-0056和伊马替尼首次被证明可减轻SLE，提示增强VISTA功能的干预措施可能对治疗SLE有效。VISTA缺陷通过促进IFN-I和非经典NF-kappaB通路的激活，加剧了pristane诱导的小鼠狼疮样疾病。通过分子对接、SPR和细胞水平实验，伊马替尼被筛选为一种小分子VISTA激动剂。VISTA激动剂（M351-0056和伊马替尼）通过抑制IFN-I和非经典NF-kappaB通路的激活，缓解了cGVHD小鼠模型和MRL/lpr小鼠的狼疮样疾病进展。
